async function run(items, op) {
	for (const item of items) {
		try {
			await op(item);
		} finally {
			log(item);
		}
	}
	for (const item of items)
		switch (item.kind) {
			case "a":
				await op(item);
				break;
			default:
				break;
		}
	for (const item of items) {
		const callback = async () => {
			await op(item);
		};
		use(callback);
	}
	for (const item of items) {
		const result = await (async () => op(item))();
	}
	for (let i = await start(); i < items.length; i++) {
		use(i);
	}
	for (let i = 0; await more(i); i++) {
		use(i);
	}
}
